note: Human-reviewed mapping between endpoints observed in the Brevo UI (internal services) and the public-API catalog actions that accomplish the same business action. Equivalence is about capability, not wire compatibility: host, auth, paths and payloads differ.

mappings.notes: UI posts to contacts-api-v2 /lists/create (201, {id}). Public API posts to api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/lists. The HAR did not capture the UI request body (bodySize=0).
UI deletes via contacts-api-v2 /lists/{id} (204). Public API deletes /contacts/lists/{listId}.
UI posts to contacts-api /contact/backend/contacts/add-contact (200, {contact_id}). Public API posts /contacts. The HAR did not capture the UI request body (bodySize=0).
UI deletes via contacts-api /contact/backend/contacts/{id} (200). Public API deletes /contacts/{identifier}.

mappings.business_action: Add a contact to one or more lists
mappings.notes: UI updates contact list membership via contacts-api /contact/backend/contacts/lists. Public API exposes /contacts/lists/{listId}/contacts/add. The UI call may combine membership changes.
UI body: {attributes:{name,owner,domain}, linkedContactsIds, linkedDealsIds, gtm}. Public API posts /companies with a different schema. This is the clearest payload-level difference captured.
UI deletes via crm-backend-api /crm/backend/company/{id} (204). Public API deletes /companies/{id}.
UI reads contacts-api-v2 /lists/get-lists. Public API reads GET /contacts/lists.
UI reads contacts-api-v2 /lists/get-folders. Public API reads GET /contacts/folders.
UI reads contacts-api /contact/backend/contacts/{id}. Public API reads GET /contacts/{identifier}.
UI reads contacts-api /contact/backend/settings/get-attributes. Public API reads GET /contacts/attributes.

mappings.business_action: List lists and segments for contact assignment
mappings.notes: UI returns folders, lists and segments in one call. Public API splits this into GET /contacts/lists and GET /contacts/segments.
UI reads crm-backend-api /crm/backend/companies. Public API reads GET /companies.
UI reads crm-backend-api /crm/backend/company/{id}. Public API reads GET /companies/{id}.
UI reads crm-backend-api /crm/backend/attribute/companies. Public API reads GET /crm/attributes/companies.
UI reads crm-backend-api /crm/backend/attributes/deals. Public API reads GET /crm/attributes/deals.
UI sends {fe_query, page, limit, force_refresh} to segments-api /segment/query. Public API exposes GET /contacts with different pagination/filter parameters.
UI gets counts from segments-api /segment/count. The public API has no dedicated count endpoint; a caller must paginate GET /contacts.

UI setup body: {camp_name, folder_path, tag_ids} -> 201 {id}, then the editor loads the campaign. Public API POST /emailCampaigns takes the full campaign definition (sender, subject, recipients, content) in one call.
UI deletes via email-campaigns-backend /email-campaign/api/campaigns. Public API deletes /emailCampaigns/{campaignId}.

mappings.ui_path: Marketing > Modelos > Criar modelo > Modelo de e-mail
mappings.notes: UI body includes {name, subject, from_email, from_name, sender_id, content, reply_to, tag, tracking}. Public API POST /smtp/templates uses sender/templateName/subject/htmlContent and a different tracking shape.
UI deletes via email-campaigns-backend /email-template/api/templates. Public API deletes /smtp/templates/{templateId}.

mappings.ui_path: Marketing > Formulários > Criar um formulário de inscrição
mappings.notes: No public API equivalent. The observed internal endpoint forms-api /forms-api/forms (201) confirms the UI-only action and its response shape. The request body was not captured (bodySize=0).
